dedupe_keys.name: arcep annual survey for sustainable digital environmental footprint of networks and data centres

description: Arcep's annual survey for a sustainable digital sector publishes indicators on the environmental footprint of digital services in France. It started in 2020 with the four main electronic communications operators (Orange, SFR, Bouygues Telecom, Free), giving their greenhouse gas emissions, electricity consumption of fixed and mobile networks, energy per subscriber and equipment sales and refurbishment; later editions added device manufacturers, data-centre operators, mobile network equipment makers and, in the fifth edition, fibre-optic cable makers. Coverage: France, annual, for data years from 2020. Format and access: XLSX tables on data.gouv.fr with an annual report on arcep.fr; free under the Licence Ouverte (Etalab). Caveats: aggregated by sector, not by site; scope grew each edition, so series are not fully comparable; values are declared by companies. Simulation uses: environmental impact and electricity demand of telecom networks and data centres for energy planning and climate adaptation studies. Related records: the EU data-centre energy performance database, the LBNL US data-centre report and IEA Energy and AI give comparable figures elsewhere.
